name: Modification of Critical Security Policy Registry Keys
description: A registry value related to a core security feature (e.g., Windows Defender, UAC, Firewall, AppLocker) was modified. This feature indicates a potential attempt to weaken system defenses.

action.description: A critical security policy registry key was modified. SIEM should analyze the responsible process and user context.

operational_usage: While some admin tools might trigger this, any modification by a non-system or non-admin-tool process is highly suspicious. This is a strong feature for detecting defense evasion.
false_positive: Can be triggered by Group Policy updates or legitimate administrative scripts. Baselining is important.
